label: Product Owner's Project package is hand-written under a four-step manual parity method: list sources against counterparts, decide which paragraphs apply, check the read-only drift list, and record each review as a dated sentence.
No manifest, lock file or checksum ledger is kept; the retired compiler's sync file and generated regions were archived, so parity is a reviewer obligation.

The workspace contract says a hand-written mirror proves neither human review nor deployment; review is recorded only after the named human confirms it and deployment only with a receipt and smoke evidence.

Shared rule cards live in AI Systems/z — Knowledge, and Product Owner vendors four as regular-file copies because symlinks resolve to nothing in a cloned public repo; the parity declaration names them vendored_shared_copies so a card change turns the system red until copied.

Kernel review is a human gate with a dated artifact recording reviewer, decision, kernelSha256, kernel version and aligned skill version, plus a note that nothing reads it and parity is checked by benchmark plus hand reading.
The sync surface is a three-hop manual chain (shared card to vendored copy to Project mirror) with drift detected only by comparing commit timestamps.
